verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's left-headline / centre-window / right-details banner structure with readable text, but the headline crowds the top and left edges, and the window is shrunk to a small icon that loses its role as the centrepiece. B bleeds the window off the top and bottom edges, shrinks the date and address to illegible micro-text, and squeezes everything into the left-centre with a large dead area on the right, so the headline and details sit on unrelated, misaligned axes.
